summary: Master the art of web-based GIS application development with our comprehensive training on QGIS and OpenGeo Suite. Enroll today for expert guidance!
lede: Web GIS development helps GIS technicians, database administrators, and web developers turn prepared spatial data into browser-based maps and services. Learners practise validating QGIS data and designing PostGIS schemas, then publish OGC services and build OpenLayers map functions. They also work with SLD styling, service access controls, and cache and response testing to plan a maintainable deployment.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, manage, publish, or consume spatial data through browser-based mapping systems. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who can work with basic GIS concepts and want guided practice across the QGIS, PostGIS, GeoServer, and OpenGeo Suite workflow.
modules: Web GIS Architecture and OpenGeo Suite
prerequisites: Basic GIS literacy and familiarity with layers, attributes, coordinate reference systems, and map composition are recommended. No prior programming experience is required, although basic HTML or JavaScript exposure will help with the OpenLayers exercises. You should be comfortable using a desktop computer, managing files, and following technical configuration instructions. No prior coding experience is needed. OpenLayers configuration and Docker workflows are taught at operational application level, while production-grade software engineering, enterprise infrastructure design, and advanced database administration remain outside the course scope.
